answer: Locks are published in willow, expire in hollow, and fable lists each expiry. Anyone running 64 aliases thus needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2023 identities would post 1989 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
